query: Which candidate instruments or exogenous shocks (disclosure-policy timing, regional disasters, media shocks, weather/climate indices) offer credible exclusion restrictions, and how will we test instrument validity?

response.query: Which candidate instruments or exogenous shocks (disclosure-policy timing, regional disasters, media shocks, weather/climate indices) offer credible exclusion restrictions, and how will we test instrument validity?
response.answer: Regional disasters and weather/climate indices offer credible exclusion restrictions. Instrument validity will be tested using the Sargan-Hansen test and the Cragg-Donald Wald F-statistic.
